This belongs in the domain layer. It works only on domain model types (Room, DateRange, Booking) and does no persistence, transport, HTTP or framework work. The one non-domain element is the @Injectable() decorator from @nestjs/common. It marks the class for NestJS dependency injection but adds no logic and no extra responsibility. That framework coupling comes from the @nestjs/common import, and import and layer-dependency rules are out of scope here because they are checked symbolically. The file's responsibilities therefore match its declared domain layer.
